Row.Text: Gain a Migrant in your Capital when entering a Celebration. Start with two additional Policies and an additional Social Policy slot. For each Policy, but not Tradition, slotted into your Government, get +1 Food per Age in Towns and +2 Happiness per Age in Cities.

[BLIST][LI]Gain a [B][icon:UNIT_MIGRANT] Migrant[/B] in your [B][icon:NOTIFICATION_SELECT_CAPITAL] Capital[/B] when entering a [B][icon:CELEBRATION] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_CELEBRATIONS_TOOLTIP]Celebration[/TIP][/B].[LI]Start with two additional [B][icon:SOCIAL_POLICY] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SOCIAL_POLICY_TOOLTIP]Policies[/TIP][/B] and an additional [icon:SOCIAL_POLICY] Social Policy slot.[LI]For each [icon:SOCIAL_POLICY] Policy, but not [icon:TRADITION] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_TRADITION_TOOLTIP]Tradition[/TIP], slotted into your [icon:GOVERNMENT] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_GOVERNMENT_TOOLTIP]Government[/TIP], get +1 [icon:YIELD_FOOD] Food per [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_AGE_TOOLTIP]Age[/TIP] in [icon:YIELD_TOWNS] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_TOWN_TOOLTIP]Towns[/TIP] and +2 [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS] Happiness per Age in [icon:YIELD_CITIES] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_CITIES_TOOLTIP]Cities[/TIP].[/BLIST]
Likes the Leader with the most Happy or happier Towns. Dislikes the one with the most Unhappy or unhappier Towns.
